title: TARSActionResult
description: Canonical result of a TARSActionRequest (Wave 2A). Every requested/executed/denied/blocked action produces exactly one ActionResult, correlated by request_id, which is also the unit the permission-engine audit trail records. Shared by the backend, the action runtime, and the native shell/HUD.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bump on any breaking change and record a new ADR in DECISIONS.md.

status.description: Terminal or in-flight status. DENIED = rejected by the permission engine (e.g. user declined a confirmation prompt); BLOCKED = never eligible for execution regardless of confirmation (RiskLevel.BLOCKED).

risk_level.description: The RiskLevel the permission engine classified this request as. Required for a genuine audit trail of what was requested, at what risk, and what happened -- never null once a result reaches a terminal status.

summary.description: Short human-readable description of what happened, shown in the HUD and the audit log. Must describe the actual outcome -- never a fabricated/optimistic result.

data.description: Structured, skill-specific result payload (e.g. matched files, launched process id). Empty object when there is nothing structured to report.

error.description: Non-null when status is FAILED/DENIED/BLOCKED, describing what went wrong or why the action did not proceed.
